description: Main entry point for a Flutter application implementing an attendance tracker. It sets up providers for authentication, attendance, and reports, defines the root widget with theme configurations, and controls navigation between login and main screens based on authentication state.

classes.name: AttendanceApp
classes.description: Root widget applying themes and setting up providers for the application.

classes.name: _AuthGate
classes.description: Widget that manages navigation based on authentication state, displaying either a loading indicator, the main app shell, or the login screen.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes environment, bindings, and runs the root widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for AttendanceApp, configuring providers and themes.
